name: The Dating World of TFS
source:
Hey! You! The one reading this!

Have you ever wanted to date fictional characters made by some people you like watching?

Have you wanted to look deeper into each character's personality and lore?

Are you just simply looking for a visual novel with a linear storyline for each character?

No?

Well, too bad.

[From [url=https://wondergamer101.itch.io/the-dating-world-of-tfs] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
嘿！就是你！正在读这段文字的人！

你是否曾想和某些你喜欢观看的人创作的虚构角色约会？

你是否想深入了解每个角色的性格与背景？

你只是想找一部每个角色都有线性故事的视觉小说？

没有？

那真遗憾。

（来源：[url=https://wondergamer101.itch.io/the-dating-world-of-tfs]itch.io[/url]）
